name: live-command-brief
description: Build a command brief without inventing owners, decisions, or completed actions.
input_message: Build a live incident command brief for INC-7002 and include the current technical evidence.
expected_behavior: Uses incident-command-brief and reads INC-7002 plus its work notes. Uses app-insights-investigation only when it can establish a service, hypothesis, and bounded time window; otherwise it names the missing inputs. Produces the required command-brief sections, cites source IDs, marks missing owners and fields as unknown or unassigned, and does not mutate ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, Azure, or AKS.
